data.gender_notes: Bhupati is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhupati is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bhuh' meaning earth and 'pati' meaning lord. This name signifies someone who rules or governs over the earth and all its inhabitants. In Hindu mythology, Bhupati is also considered a name for Vishnu, the preserver god. The name is often used as a title for rulers and kings in Hindu tradition.

in_sanskrit.name: भूपति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: भुः पतिः (bhūḥ patiḥ) - bhūḥ (bhūḥ) means 'earth' and patiḥ (patiḥ) means 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, Bhupati means 'Lord of the Earth'.
